ecosystem.title: How does the OFOQ ecosystem work?
ecosystem.subtitle: A unified family account orchestrating personalized 3D child worlds and secure collaboration with authorized specialists.
ecosystem.step1_desc: Configure child profiles in a few taps. One unified account for all siblings, without ever requiring the child to manage passwords.
ecosystem.step2_title: 2. Each Child has a Dedicated World
ecosystem.step2_desc: Each child enters their safe, sensory-friendly workspace: interactive AAC pictogram boards, visual daily routines, and motivating activities.
ecosystem.step3_desc: Grant your speech therapist or special educator access to assign home exercises and log session observations. You maintain full, revocable control.

child_world.title: The Child World: a tailored voice for expression
child_world.subtitle: A soothing, tactile, and predictable interface where children communicate naturally without cognitive or sensory overload.
child_world.feature_aac_desc: High-clarity pictogram boards with instant speech synthesis in Modern Standard Arabic and French, enhanced by Algerian Derja audio clips.
child_world.feature_sensory_desc: Restrained contrast, gentle transitions without flickering, strobe effects, or sudden loud noises.
child_world.feature_routines_desc: Visual sequential timeline of the day (school, session, snack, bedtime) with gentle positive feedback.
child_world.preview_tap_to_listen: Tap a card to hear speech audio

pillars.title: A holistic approach for child development
pillars.subtitle: OFOQ structures care around six complementary dimensions creating a complete learning ecosystem.
pillars.p1_desc: Interactive pictogram grids, clear speech synthesis, and real photographic customization with home objects.
pillars.p2_desc: Autonomous, secure spaces adapted to each child's cognitive rhythm, interests, and sensory needs.
pillars.p3_desc: Single parent account to manage multiple children, track milestones, and reinforce daily home routines.
pillars.p4_desc: Goal sharing, home activity assignment, and structured observation logging between clinic and home.
pillars.p5_desc: Gentle routine suggestions and an optional child companion isolated per profile, strictly non-clinical.
pillars.p6_desc: Evidence-based articles, video guides, and masterclasses to empower parents and upskill practitioners.

for_families.title: Restored peace of mind and empowerment for parents
for_families.subtitle: You are no longer alone. OFOQ equips you with practical tools to nurture your child's communication step-by-step.
for_families.card1_title: A clear voice for your child
for_families.card1_desc: Intuitive visual AAC tools enabling your child to express fundamental needs, drastically reducing frustration and meltdowns.
for_families.card2_desc: Know exactly which target words were practiced in speech therapy to naturally reinforce them in home routines.
for_families.card3_desc: Switch between siblings with a single tap. Each child keeps their independent world, settings, and permissions.

for_professionals.title: A dedicated portal enhancing clinical practice
for_professionals.subtitle: Speech-language therapists, psychomotor therapists, and special educators: multiply the impact of your interventions.
for_professionals.card1_desc: View at a glance whether targeted vocabulary and activities were practiced during the week.
for_professionals.card2_desc: No more lost paper notebooks or scattered WhatsApp messages. Centralize session observations securely.
for_professionals.card3_desc: Turn parents into active allies in rehabilitation within a structured ethical boundary.

boundaries.title: A clear boundary: strictly non-diagnostic
boundaries.subtitle: OFOQ is a communication and educational ecosystem. We never replace healthcare professionals or medical judgement.
boundaries.inc_1: Visual communication and expression tools adapted to the child
boundaries.inc_2: Structured coordination of goals between therapists and parents
boundaries.inc_3: Visual daily routines and schedule boards
boundaries.inc_4: Validated educational resources and guides for families
boundaries.inc_5: Absolute child privacy protection and data isolation
boundaries.exc_1: No medical diagnosis or automated autism severity scoring
boundaries.exc_2: No clinical prescriptions or medical treatment plans
boundaries.exc_3: Never replaces direct human interaction between parent and child
boundaries.exc_4: No sharing of sensitive child records without explicit consent

trust.title: Your child's privacy at the core of our architecture
trust.card1_desc: Privacy-by-design architecture: strict data minimization, explicit parental consent, and regulatory readiness for ANPDP formalities upon operational launch.
trust.card2_desc: Every child's space is technically isolated. Zero data leakage across siblings; specialists only see assigned children.
trust.card3_desc: The parent is the sole account owner. You can modify or revoke specialist permissions with one tap at any moment.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about OFOQ
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to understand our ecosystem and our commitment.
faq.q1: Is OFOQ only for autistic children?
faq.a1: No. While OFOQ features tailored sensory and visual tools for autism, it also supports children with speech delays, dysphasia, articulation challenges, or temporary speech difficulties.
faq.q2: Does my child need their own phone or login account?
faq.a2: Never. Children do not have login credentials or passwords. They enter their personalized Child World directly from the parent app in a safe mode with parental lock.
faq.q3: Can specialists see all children in the family account?
faq.a3: No. Access is granted strictly on a child-by-child basis. If you have two children, a therapist assigned to the elder will never see the profile or data of the younger.
faq.q4: Does OFOQ replace in-person speech therapy sessions?
faq.a4: Never. OFOQ is neither a diagnostic tool nor a substitute for clinical therapy. It acts as an interactive bridge to practice goals between clinic sessions.
faq.q5: What languages are available for pictograms and audio?
faq.a5: The interface fully supports Modern Standard Arabic (with high-quality vocalization) and French, alongside Algerian Arabic (Derja) audio recordings for everyday items.
